system.description:
Lower levels of Dominate keep most puppets in line, but not for the most exacting elders. With Chain the Psyche, any attempt to break free of your control lances the victim's skull with incapacitating pain.

Spend a Blood Trait when you use Dominate on a subject. If they try to disobey an implanted command or recover lost memories, agonizing pain leaves them unable to act for the next 10 minutes. When you use the power, decide how many attempts to resist you wish to crush and spend one Mental Trait for each; those Traits are locked for the rest of the night (a Willpower Trait restores all Mental Traits as normal). The power fades once every purchased attempt has been made.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait, plus one Mental Trait per resisted attempt crushed
system.duration: Until the set number of resistance attempts are exhausted
